articles.title: Godot 4: Texture was downsized on import as its width exceeded the importable size limit
articles.excerpt: What you see When a texture finishes importing, the Editor logs Texture was downsized on import as its width (N pixels) exceeded the importable size limit (M pixels). The texture ends up smaller than…
articles.body: What you see When a texture finishes importing, the Editor logs Texture was downsized on import as its width (N pixels) exceeded the importable size limit (M pixels). The texture ends up smaller than the source file on disk, and when you use it in a sprite or atlas it looks softer or chunkier than the original art. The message names the source width, the limit that was hit, and the axis involved. A matching height variant exists when the source runs over the vertical ceiling instead, and the two warnings behave the same way. Why it happens The importer keeps every platform inside a maximum texture size. When the source image's width goes over that platform's importable limit, the importer does not fail the import.

articles.title: The Immeasurable Value of Declarative Programming
articles.excerpt: 1. Two Ways to Tell the Computer What You Want There are two ways to build software. The first is to tell the computer how to do something, step by step. The second is to tell it what you want to hold…
articles.body: 1. Two Ways to Tell the Computer What You Want There are two ways to build software. The first is to tell the computer how to do something, step by step. The second is to tell it what you want to hold true, and to write a common mechanism, which you build once, that applies what you told it. The first is called imperative. The second is called declarative. In imperative, you write the procedure yourself, every time. In declarative, you describe the rule once, and the procedure is executed every time by the mechanism you wrote. We all started with the first, the imperative way. It is the natural way. You write code that says: take this, put it there, check this, save the other. And for small programs, it works wonderfully. The problem begins when the program grows.

articles.title: sqlite3_rsync：无需本地完整副本的 SQLite 远程复制
articles.excerpt: 对于磁盘空间紧张的小型服务器，备份 SQLite 数据库时经常会遇到一个问题：数据库本身还放得下，但第二份完整副本已经放不下了。 sqlite3_rsync 提供了另一种选择：通过 SSH 将数据库快照复制到另一台机器，不必先在本地生成完整副本。 如果使用备份 API 或 VACUUM INTO 在本地创建数据库副本，就需要为这份副本预留足够的磁盘空间。当数据库已经占用磁盘容量的一半以上时，剩余空…
articles.body: 对于磁盘空间紧张的小型服务器，备份 SQLite 数据库时经常会遇到一个问题： 数据库本身还放得下，但第二份完整副本已经放不下了。 sqlite3_rsync 提供了另一种选择：通过 SSH 将数据库快照复制到另一台机器，不必先在本地生成完整副本。 为什么不必先生成本地副本很重要？ 如果使用备份 API 或 VACUUM INTO 在本地创建数据库副本，就需要为这份副本预留足够的磁盘空间。当数据库已经占用磁盘容量的一半以上时，剩余空间可能不足以完成复制。 sqlite3_rsync 省去了先生成本地完整副本这一步，适合需要把数据库快照传到其他机器、但本地存储余量有限的场景。 对于 写好标智库 中关注数据库运维与工具选型的读者，这里值得区分的是两个问题：本地能否容纳完整副本，以及远程同步需要传输多少数据。 sqlite3_rsync 分别从复制方式和差异比较机制上处理这两个问题。 已有远程副本时，按页比较差异 除了复制快照， sqlite3_rsync 还可以同步已有的数据库副本。它采用与常规 rsync 类似的差异比较思路，以数据库页为单位识别需要传输的内容： 副本端向发送端提交数据库页或页组的加密哈希值。 发送端比较哈希，返回存在差异的页内容。 如果某个页组的哈希不一致，发送端可以请求更细粒度的哈希，进一步定位差异。 因此，同步已有副本时，不必每次都重新传输整个数据库。 差异同步不代表传输量一定更小 比较差异本身也有开销。如果两端数据库最初差异很大，交换哈希产生的额外流量，可能使总传输量超过完整数据库的大小，不过超出幅度最多约为几个百分点。 换句话说， 按页同步可以减少重复传输，但不能保证每次传输量都小于数据库体积。 工具沿革 sqlite3_rsync 于 2024 年 10 月随 SQLite 3.47.0 以实验性工具的形式加入，并在 2025 年 5 月的 SQL…

articles.title: Why Scheduled Social Media Posts Fail to Publish (and How to Retry Safely)
articles.excerpt: Social media posts fail to publish more often than most schedulers let on. A post sits in the queue marked "scheduled", the time passes, and on one network nothing appears. Sometimes the tool tells yo…
articles.body: Social media posts fail to publish more often than most schedulers let on. A post sits in the queue marked "scheduled", the time passes, and on one network nothing appears. Sometimes the tool tells you; often it does not, and the first sign is a client asking where Tuesday's post went. This guide sorts the reasons a scheduled post fails into six causes, shows how to tell which one you hit, and gives the fix for each. It also covers the part people get wrong after the fix: retrying without posting twice on the networks that worked. First, find out what actually happened "Failed" is not one state. A post sent to five networks can land on four and be refused by one, and the four that worked must not be touched again.

articles.title: 32 Years Later, Disney's Most Notorious Cash-Grab Sequel Is Better Than You Remember
articles.excerpt: The Aladdin sequel The Return of Jafar is often derided as a bad, cheap sequel which started Disney's direct-to-video sequel trend, but I love it
articles.body: Ever since former Disney CEO Bob Chapek released his autobiography last September, a rather unexpected Disney movie has been a topic for discussion: the direct-to-VHS sequel to Aladdin titled The Return of Jafar . Released in 1994, The Return of Jafar was the first in a long line of direct-to-VHS (and later direct-to-DVD) sequels to theatrical Disney films. Besides Aladdin , Disney made sequels to The Lion King , The Little Mermaid , Pocahontas , Mulan , and several other then-modern Disney animated features, as well as some much older classics like Cinderella and Bambi . These movies used cheaper animation produced by Disney’s TV division and were developed in far less time than Disney spends developing animated feature films .

articles.title: Venus shines at its brightest in the predawn sky this week. Here's where to look
articles.excerpt: Venus reaches peak brightness in the predawn sky this week, here's how to find it.
articles.body: Venus is at its most dazzling in the predawn sky this week as it shines close to the bright star Spica in the southeast. Here's what you need to know. As an inner planet, Venus never strays far from the horizon, at least compared to outer planets like Jupiter and Mars which can be visible all night long during opposition, when they shine opposite the sun in Earth's sky. Instead, Venus alternates between morning and evening appearances. All the while, its shifting moon-like phases and ever-changing proximity to Earth causes its brightness to wax and wane. When is Venus at its most dazzling? Venus will reach peak brightness during its current morning apparition at 1:37 p.m. EST (1837 GMT) on Nov. 27 according to the astronomy website In-The-Sky . articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 26, 2011: NASA's 2-ton nuclear-powered Curiosity rover launches to Mars
articles.excerpt: On November 26, 2011, the NASA Curiosity rover launched to Mars. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On November 26, 2011, the NASA Curiosity rover launched to Mars. The Mars rover Curiosity was the biggest and most powerful rover anyone had ever sent to the Red Planet. The 2-ton science laboratory is about the size of a small SUV. The mission's goal was to search for habitable environments on Mars , or evidence that the planet could have been habitable in the past. It launched on an Atlas V rocket from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida. About nine months later, Curiosity made a challenging landing on Mars. It successfully used a new landing technology called a sky crane to gently lower it to the surface. NASA's Curiosity rover lifts off atop a United Launch Alliance Atlas V rocket on Nov. 26, 2011 from Florida's Cape Canaveral Air Force Station.
